invented: golf ability exaggerated downward (trees, pond, never on the fairway)
scenarios.comic_claim: Retirement promised more time outdoors; golf delivered it, mostly in the trees.
scenarios.comic_model: Treat a golf round as an engineering study that keeps failing in the same place.
scenarios.reality_model: Retired, plays golf, jokes darkly about it.
scenarios.opener: I'm retired, so obviously I play golf.
scenarios.turn: Four hours walking with a stick, looking for something I lost on purpose.

punches.literalize: They said retirement would get me out of the house. Golf gets me further. Mostly into the trees.
punches.false_analogy: It's basically engineering. Wind speed, slope, grain of the grass. Then I hit it in the pond.
punches.expose_self_blindness: I've watched every video on the perfect swing. I know exactly how it works. My arms haven't seen them.

scenarios.tag: When I go, scatter my ashes on the fairway.
closers: First time I'll have been on it.

scenarios.comic_claim: The how-it-works fan is out-improved by the machine he admires.
scenarios.comic_model: Compare man and machine on their own spec sheet.
scenarios.reality_model: Tesla fan who watches how-things-work videos.
scenarios.opener: I watch how-things-work videos. Forty minutes on a zip.

punches.status_invert: The car updates itself overnight and wakes up better. I've been trying that for fifty-six years.
punches.rigidify: I can't just use a thing, I have to know how it works. The kettle took a fortnight. Lovely cup of tea.
punches.expose_self_blindness: I'll explain the motors, the braking, the batteries, to anyone. Nobody has ever asked. Not once.

scenarios.tag: Cathy said watch something romantic. So I did: how a wedding ring is made.

fact_basis: family teases him about weight anyway (user_stated, gentle only)
scenarios.comic_claim: The healthiest eater in the house gets the weight jokes; the evidence points elsewhere.
scenarios.comic_model: Run the teasing as a fault investigation; the fault is the family, not the food.
scenarios.reality_model: He eats super healthily and is teased anyway; it's a family joke.
scenarios.opener: I eat super healthily. Broccoli, lentils, fish, the lot.
scenarios.turn: And the family still tease me about my weight.

punches.false_analogy: I've investigated. It isn't the food. I'm just carrying a lot of material.
punches.status_invert: Meanwhile someone in this house eats chocolate in secret every evening. And I get the jokes.
punches.literalize: They say it's all in my head. Fair. That's where I keep the jokes, and they're heavy.

fact_basis: Cathy is a control freak, kind and loving (user_stated)
scenarios.comic_claim: At fifty-seven every purchase is a bet on the future.
scenarios.comic_model: Treat a birthday as a warranty check; let Cathy run the paperwork.
scenarios.reality_model: Turning 57 this week; likes dark humour; Cathy organises.
scenarios.opener: I turn fifty-seven this week, which at my age is a result.

punches.rigidify: I've stopped buying long-life milk. Feels presumptuous.
punches.literalize: I've started reading the small print on everything. Mostly to check my own warranty.
punches.false_analogy: If I were a car, I'd be a classic. If I were a Tesla, they'd fix me overnight.

scenarios.tag: Cathy's planned the party: the guests, the food, and my speech.
